answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the garden queue naming the wharf that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 12 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Thus, every sock puppet costs 12 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the basalt record publishes exactly who is still on probation. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
